I am still planning to upload more retextures! I have a few designs already done (silo,only one cabin so far, junimo hut, etc.) but I need to implement and test them.
I upload previews on my [url=https://www.tumblr.com/howasstardewcorner]Tumblr[/url]!

 [img]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfx4ZGAK6-NlnOMmSuzzJXT6Nwte9CMkG7nA62LOETE_tiQ0jKtAySM5uGymSHbss7akgC8I_d9uXYOACnAWVzbFtZFAkiOSBuOU5wAaVrIexyR8YcEHDRusSq_SCFogrWRcqSDxg?key=SworC8vVRoJ2neaPIeQuwg[/img]


I started this series because I found myself excitedly checking through [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/FlashShifter?gameId=1303&pk_vid=b8cc2fa761b328a61755051662c71015]Flashshifter[/url]﻿'s Patreon for news of SVE's Castle Village update/sequel mod, and I got the itch to create some castle-themed Stardew art, so here we are! S.O. to Flashshifter, their creativity is catching. I studied their art style and the color palettes from Lance's Highlands Outpost to design the castles.


As always, the flowers on the decorated versions and the baskets of eggs are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20139]HxW Tilesheets[/url]﻿, a gigantic thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/HimeTarts?gameId=1303]HimeTarts[/url]﻿ and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Wildflourmods?gameId=1303]Wildflour[/url]﻿ for their beautiful mods and for making their work available for the community to use.


To everyone who has reached out to share their appreciation for the series 🥹, thank you all!
